whatThePageStates: The page is a catalogue of the finding types that Amazon GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring can generate from operating-system-level behaviour on EC2 hosts and on containers in EKS clusters, Fargate and ECS workloads. A short intro paragraph plus a Note about sanitizing runtime log fields is followed by a Topics list of 46 links, then one H2 section per finding type. Each section gives the finding name as the H2, a one-sentence H3 description, a Default severity line, a single bullet reading Feature: Runtime Monitoring, an explanatory body, and Remediation recommendations. There are no tables, no Yes/No columns, no Region list, no plan or scan-method dimension, and no statement anywhere that any finding type, resource, platform, or Region is unsupported. The only coverage claim the page makes is the membership of the catalogue itself: these 46 named finding types exist for the Runtime Monitoring feature.

features.statuses: 46 present, 0 absent-and-stated; 46+0=46. Every entry is a positive existence claim - a named finding type GuardDuty can generate under the Runtime Monitoring feature. There is no second status value on this page: no No, no Partial, no deprecated or retired marker, no 'not available in' note. Not-supported is never STATED here, only absent, so nothing may be counted as a negative. Count verified four independent ways: 46 Topics bullets naming finding types (the raw '+ [' bullet count is 48, but two of those are CVE reference links inside the PrivilegeEscalation:Runtime/RuncContainerEscape section, not topics), 46 H2 headings excluding the trailing 'See also' H2, 46 'Default severity:' lines (21 High + 18 Medium + 4 Low + 3 Variable = 46), and 46 'Feature: Runtime Monitoring' bullets. All 46 H2 names are distinct - sort -u returns 46.
features.scope: None. There is no second dimension. Severity (High/Medium/Low/Variable) is an attribute of each finding, not a coverage scope, and 'Variable' is a severity value, not a Partial coverage status. The Feature field is the constant 'Runtime Monitoring' on all 46, so it partitions nothing. The intro names EC2 hosts, EKS containers, Fargate and ECS workloads in prose, but no finding is mapped to a resource type or platform, so there is no per-resource-type or per-platform matrix to read.
features.reasoning: findingType is the right axis because the page's unit of assertion is one named GuardDuty finding string (for example Execution:Runtime/NewBinaryExecuted), published by GuardDuty about its own detections - a catalogue axis, not an external universe. The unit of claim is the finding type, not the section, the severity, or the threat family: rows and axis values are one-to-one at 46, so no collapse applies and distinctTargets is omitted. Grouping by prefix (Execution, DefenseEvasion, PrivilegeEscalation, Trojan, Impact, Persistence, Discovery, Backdoor, CryptoCurrency, UnauthorizedAccess) would be a threatCategory rollup the page never presents as its own list, and would wrongly reduce the count.

shouldNotExtract: The 'Topics' list is a duplicate navigation index of the same 46 H2 sections - counting both would double to 92. The two CVE bullets in PrivilegeEscalation:Runtime/RuncContainerEscape (CVE-2019-5736 and CVE-2024-21626) are vulnerability references, not finding types or coverage values. The 7 'Note' blocks and 1 'Note:' block, the 45 'Remediation recommendations:' headings, the 'Default severity:' lines, the constant 'Feature: Runtime Monitoring' bullets, the H3 one-line descriptions, the testing instructions naming dig/nslookup and the guarddutyc2activityb.com test domain, all remediation and suppression-rule cross-links, and the trailing 'See also' section with its Agent Toolkit for AWS coding-assistant boilerplate are all non-coverage. The 'See also' H2 must not be counted as a 47th finding type.
coverageDimensions: REGION: nothing. The word 'region' does not appear on the page at all; any per-Region figure attributed to this page is fabricated. SERVICE: nothing enumerable. The intro mentions Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS and Fargate in a single prose sentence describing what Runtime Monitoring observes, and finding names contain a 'Runtime' scope token rather than a service token - there is no service-by-service list or matrix, so no service count can be taken from this page. RESOURCE TYPE: nothing enumerable. Several sections say the runtime agent 'monitors events from multiple resource types' and tell the reader to check the Resource type field in the console, which is an explicit deferral, not an enumeration. The only dimension this page actually supplies is the finding-type catalogue: 46 values.
trap: The single most likely misparse is counting the Topics navigation list and the H2 sections as separate evidence and reporting 92, or counting the raw bullet list as 48 by including the two CVE reference links inside the RuncContainerEscape section. Runners-up: counting the H2s as 47 by including 'See also'; treating 'Default severity: Variable' (3 findings) as a Partial coverage status when it is only a severity value; reading the prose mention of EC2/EKS/ECS/Fargate as a resource-type or service coverage claim with a count of 3 or 4; collapsing the 46 finding types into their ~10 threat-family prefixes; and, most damaging, inventing not-supported entries - this page states no negative coverage anywhere, so any No or absent count derived from it is invented.
